t: Remove 10 crates of aluminum cucumbers and 7 trash bins from the stage.

The next request has been filed: trash needs to be taken out. Hey, don't you go making faces like that! We want to hold a gig for the city's people, but the communal services have piled up trash in the only suitable venue. Again. Someone's stacked trash bins and crates of aluminum cucumbers upon the stage. We need to remove all of that quickly so that the venue can be prepared for the performance. I entrust this job to you! Make sure everything is moved out so the musicians can start rehearsing on time.

Gauging the morale of our citizens is an important part of our work. Everyone must be happy and content, this increases labor productivity. And that brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Find Sarbaz Rabiya and bring her to Nomarkh Khey.
Robobeasts! Tep take them! I knew they would be up to doing something nasty. This gang is becoming more and more dangerous.
Find Sarbaz Ekayb and bring her to Nomarkh Khey, eliminating robobeasts along the way.
Robobeasts are a separate problem resulting from the careless conduct by Negus Pilis! But we're solving it as well, so you ought to know that the completion of the Wireframe project is nearing!
Help with tuning 6 pieces of equipment.
What took you so long? Here are the instruments, get started! We still have a lot to do...
Oh, this is the veritable music of the celestial spheres! We're gonna rock so hard that Rysina will be bouncing in her Nezebgrad!
Help with tuning 6 pieces of equipment.

The next request has been filed: the musicians want help in tuning their equipment. I think of offering the task to you, since you have been doing something like this before. Xadagan is full of various shemau: these are the artistic teams, and the kheni are their fans. As such, organizing concerts is an important process and a way of fulfilling the demands of the society!

Excellent, we'll be able to start the gig soon! Preparation is always the most important part. And a gig that turns out well means the happy populace... and getting closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
We believe that music is capable of changing the world... at least for a moment.
Replace 7 street posters with portraits of Yasker.
She told you to do what?
Is that woman gone now? Alright, and then we'll replace the posters right back! By the way, do you know why Yasker's shaved off his moustache? Neither do I!
Replace 7 street posters near the concert venue with portraits of Yasker.

Yes, I've already been commended for my vigilance! See, they're noticing all kinds of perversions strictly prohibited by the Code of the Imperial Future's Builder! The way it's going, they can even fine us... But so far, we're free of oversight, and therefore closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

Greetings!

Are you ready to collaborate? (Yes / No)

Are you ready to eliminate the common threat? (Yes / No)

Are you ready to receive the required information? (Yes / No)
Find 6 leaks on the power cable by using the leak detector.
Eliminate 12 of Tep's Cultists and find their taskmaster somewhere deep in the Mana Station's communication lines. Find the possible tunneling spot.

Thank you for the cooperation.

Evaluating necessities...

Analysing possibilities...

Issuing tasks...

Goal: recovering the initial program.

Method: eliminating violators.

Quantitative parameter: 12 creatures, gender male/female.

Description: Tep's Cultists Cult of Tep — organization. Leader — Tep. Multiple breaches of defensive perimeter.

Further communication possible following request execution.

Thank you for the cooperation, . Information concerning you has been extracted from the Jeb-net, complete analysis performed.

Basic information is required to create an efficient communication channel.

Reference: the Integral is the highest form of life, created by the Mechanoid community, initial location: location marked as "Mechanoids' Lair".
Enter the underground communication lines of the Mana Station and eliminate 12 of Tep's Cultists.

We think, therefore we exist. Intelligence is sacred no matter the carrier: metal or flesh.

All sapient beings must be free. Eternal condemnation to Tep and every slave owner.

There are divine creatures in Sarnaut, but there is no God. No one in this world is perfect, no one deserves to be worshipped.

There is no God, but It will be! The godly conscience of the Integral will be the pinnacle of being.

Ceaselessly improve your body and mind. By building oneself, you are building the Integral.

Efficient work is based on honest labor and delegation of responsibilities. Engineers design, workers build, guards protect.

The supreme goal of any intelligent creature is to join the godly conscience of the Integral.

If one is not willing to join the Integral, the one is not yet ready. No one must be forced to do join. This is abomination before the Integral.

The Integral cannot create oneself. For the sake of the Integral, the Harbinger and the Priests will delay their integration in order to take care of the Genesis.

The Integral is appealing from the Future. Listen to it. Come to it.

...

Enter your query.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Ask the Integral about the ways of fixing energy losses. To do this, you need to switch 4 levers in the following order: North-East-South-West.

The goal is rebooting the entire system. Remote maintenance work required. Maintenance performer required. Motivation − a reward. Size − standard.

Are you ready to collaborate, ? (Yes / No)

Are you ready to receive the required information, ? (Yes / No)
Have you found the cause of the blackouts?

, it turns out that Tep's Cultists were responsible for all of this, since they hooked a machine superintelligence to the electric grid and made it calculate what Nefer Ur is up to?

Fascinating... that would've made a great song!
I have spent many long years studying Tep's path... But I have been unable to finish my works!
Switch 4 levers in the required order: North-East-South-West.

That was magnificient! I hope there will be many such performances ahead of us, and you deserve our most exalted gratitude!

I hope you will be able to find that which you are looking for, .

The next request has been filed: holding the concert with the Cinema band. I think that since you're so well acquainted with these musicians, it won't be too hard to hold this kind of cultural event! The fans have already assembled, the musicians are ready as well, so everyone's only waiting for you. So, let's roll! You will soon become a celebrity not unlike Nomarkh Khey!

All right, I'll help you, , but you got to help me too! See, I have no spare hands either, hehe! The problem goes like that: all of the animals on our allod have gone extinct for a while, except the few most resilient species, mutated... We thought we were well rid of the rats as well! But actually, they get here on ships, then infest all the nooks and crannies, start chewing on the cables, the braiding... anything that looks even remotely edible!

We don't need this kind of critters here, so will you kindly thin their ranks a little!
The rats have been nibbling on the power cable today, but they just might chew through someone's neural cord tomorrow!

Yes, I've heard that squeaking − the sound of dying rats! I wish we could run such a deratting more frequently. I ought to submit a request to the city's department so they send me someone to do it regularly! Take it, here's the left leg of your comrade!

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Carry 3 heavy crates to the ship.
What's been taking you so long? They were about to disassemble me for spare parts! Haven't I told you: this allod is dangerous! But you didn’t believe me! No amount of denial is going to help now!
Ah... So much to drag around...
Carry 3 heavy crates to the ship.
Well, the request is done, the cargo is loaded, which means another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

The next request has been filed: our Mechanoid Workers are in disarray again. They need servicing and tuning so they can be working efficiently again. Mechanoids can be finicky, so it's important to pay attention to each one of them, and perform full troubleshooting. I'm sure you know how to handle them. I entrust this task to you − just be sure to work without haste and check up every Mechanoid thoroughly!

Today's task: wreck the hacked Robotic Lifters in the city's port. The hacker, Negus Vanvaeck, was toying with them... as if she had nothing better to do!

Yes, yes, you heard it right, ladlass: instead of doing their job, the robots are dancing to the music and tossing cargo left and right. Let's show them that the party is over, and it's time to go back to reality! You have everything you might need to fight this mechanical bacchanalia: from heavy machinery to the good old method of "turning the power off first".

But be careful: Vanvaeck may try and bring her toys back to life. So you have to be prepared for a real battle between man and machine!

The robots do not pose a threat anymore! But you know how it happens: Vanvaeck is already making plans for hacking the new models. And we're still stuck with the Wireframe project, which is getting more and more complicated. I hope you're ready for new adventure!

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Help with installing the legs, then retrieve Yaver Bazar's right arm after finding whoever has taken it
If only there's a pack of cigarettes...
Reach Nomarkh Khey's car while avoiding the fans

Yes, sure, I found the arm, too... Is that your arm, ? I thought maybe it came from one of the fans... You can't even imagine the antics the throw to get my attention!

I need to go on business, and these mad kheni are blocking my way at every turn... Will you help me get outta here? I'll give this arm to you if you do!
So, what's there, will we be able to pass?
Get to the Mana Station district with Nomarkh Khey.
There it is, that Mana Station of yours! And I'll ride on: my girl is sick, something's happened with her prosthetics!
Well, let's go, I'll take you there!
Reach Nomarkh Khey's car while avoiding the fans

Nomarkh Khey has been saved, and that means a new gig is soon upon us! With these fans, one should be ever wary! But that means another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Excellent − let's get them installed quickly, and get out of here...
Eliminate 12 members of the Cheni and Rutess gang.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Help Yaver Bazar with getting all of his limbs back

Hey, hey, wait! I'm tired of waiting for you to run by, ! Just look at that what’s happening to me… Without arms I'm... disarmed! And without legs... I don't have a leg to stand on! Barely managing to crawl, and getting anywhere is completely out of question...

It's all the fault of these dumb cultists − they couldn't even set the portal up right! Tep's lost all the smart ones, only cretins like these remain now!

So, I have a suspicion all my missing limbs are somewhere around here, in the port! Try asking the superintendent.
Gotta have a check-up after all these troubles!
This is a day to forget! Anchor to my throat!

Are you right mad? Who's daft enough to use portals, especially old ones! You have the astral fleet for flying, with amenities, too... But no, they jump through their portals, then we got arms and legs scattered all around! I nearly got whacked on the head now!
h: A friend of mine has arrived in pieces... maybe you've seen his prosthetics?

t: Eliminate 50 hostile or neutral creatures on Xadagan and accumulate twenty 8-bit micro chips.
Eliminate 12 members of the Yahkeb gang.
Have the Yahkebs gone off to keep suffering at home? Good, should have dealt with them a long time ago... Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: The cyberdrones are no longer threatening civilians, and that means another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Talk to Sarang Kido, Nefer Ur's agent, ask her about the latest news and go whever she suggests.
We should definitely be making haste, Nefer Ur likes punctuality.

You have arrived right in time so you can share our triumph!

We have found... one of Tep's portals! Yes, one of those built back in the times of Hickut, when Tep and his loyal followers were creating the Pyramids.

You may remember that the great necromancer has placed his Spark storage facilities all over Yul, don't you?

These portals were made for quick transportation... Of course, over the centuries, they got buried by sediment, and then, cities were built first by the surviving Junes, then the Kanians and the Xadaganians... But we've managed to unearth the entrance.

and everyone... I suppose we have a chance to solve both of our problems: you will help us with activating the portal, and we will come with you to Xadagan so that we might report our discovery. Unfortunately, even though we've already managed to unearth the portal's entrance, its full activation is still far away. We've already solved almost all of our problems, but it's getting more dangerous out here with each passing day − Sardrok is nearby, and something odd is happening there.
Excellent! Now we have everything that is required for the primary job. Of course, the hardest part is ahead of us!
Eliminate 12 skeletons near the excavation grounds.
Put an end to the witless undead − it's enough that we, the Arisen, are here!
Could it really be silence? Am I no longer hearing the creaking of rusty boots, nor the clanging of holey helmets? Pure bliss! Thank you...
Find 8 ancient batteries to activate the portal.

We're not going anywhere until we have enought energy! , are you seeing a Mana Station around here, perchance? Right, nor do I...

And these old portals are consuming energy like there's no tomorrow. How did they even work around this, I wonder? They were bringing in captives, slitting their throats and feeding the portals with blood magic!

You don't want us to sacrifice you, and these historians too, do you?

Then go and find batteries! They're scattered all around the place, and there's quite enough of them to start up the portal once!
I'm still waiting for the batteries! Get them here, pronto! Right now!

Hah, it looks like we won't have to slit any throats today after all... Yes, that'll be enough to fulfill our task. You got lucky.

Now we need to find a way to connect them correctly. And you may go! Go on!
Find 4 components of Tep's portal and install them to appropriate lodgements.

Tep is great! He was building it to last centuries... millennia! Isn't it marvelous that his Pyramids are still operational? Just like this portal...

But a few components are missing. Which ones exactly? If only I knew... I need to think...

However, , if you manage to collect the components that seem orphaned but looking like they might fit this portal, we can try and put all of them together...

And if it proceeds to work then, it would mean we've assembled everything correctly!
Find the components, and then we'll be able to tell what to do next!
Well, the lights are blinking, there's no smoke, nothing's blown up! It means everything was done right! O great Nih, share some of your wisdom with me...
Disable the turrets in the portal room

Excellent − we now proceed to the final phase of our operation, .

We need to reach the portal itself. Unfortunately, after the Cult of Tep was broken in the battle of the Coba Plateau, the control codes for the portal's defensive mechanisms were lost. The turrets in the dungeon are now attacking any living target, protecting the portal securely.

We need to bypass the defenses somehow. Luckily, there is an indispensable specialist among the Historians − a true veteran of infiltration and covert operations. He will be just the man we need − ask him for advice and find a way to disable the defenses.
Owie! Job's done, heh. See you at the portal!

You just poke in there, you're toast! But while I was nursing my butt, I thought of something, heh. You gotta disguise yourself! These turrets are kinda dumb − they don't get if you're alive or not. Not right away. Back in those days, they couldn't make them smart, heh.

And when you get close, disable this thang at once. Then run to the next one!
h: But how do I get really close to the turret without activating it?

t: Activate the portal on Nomarkh Jezerith's command.

Wonderful! Honestly speaking, I'm already tired of waiting for this operation to conclude. Well, thank you for the cooperation,  − I suggest we activate the portal and... see what happens next.

We will have to hold a little ritual to finalize the activation of all mechanisms and to create a stable connection between Jigran and Xadagan. I guess no one there is expecting that, heh heh.

Let's do it!
Don't tarry − we need to open the portal!
Damn it! I hate the surprises like that... The Historians are drafting all kind of rabble without checking their backgrounds... again! Alright, since we have the portal, shall we use it?

"You must return to Jigran at once to meet me. Important news have arrived from Nefer Ur, but I will tell the details when we meet."

It looks like this letter is from that Zem Arisen who was sent to Jigran by Nefer Ur in order to monitor the situation. Looks like she wants to meet you again.
Excellent! I knew you'd be interested...

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: Meet Sarang Kido and receive a new task from her.

Sarang Kido is writing to you:

"Hello, ! I hope you are done with your business at the "Library", because I have an exceedingly important lead that might help us with understanding whatever's happening on the allod of Xadagan! I suggest we meet at the "Library's" exit."
Well, how much longer do I have to wait?

Excellent! You're here...

Remember that one of the Neguses is a traitor? It's definitely not Kambizet, and not Menes, as it is clear now... But who?

I've managed to learn something about these numerous gangs that have overrun the city – all of their tracks are leading to the "Dome"... to Negus Pilis! It was him who is creating all these augmentations – those the robobeasts are using to enhance their bodies...

It was thanks to him that the priests once became who they were – so if we want to find out whether he's connected to them in any way, we need to go to the "Dome" and scout it out...

I was able to make you a deputy assistant at the Dome − had to forge the papers. So they're already expecting you to come and start the job. You can go right now, . I don't think anyone will suspect you of anything, especially since no one will give you any complicated tasks for the time being anyway. Learn what Negus Pilis is doing there, for starters.
So, when is the test specimen going to be brought back?!
Buy a rare cartridge of games and give it to Ahbu to convince him to come to the dome for continuing the experiments.
Were you able to bring Ahbu back?
Buy a rare cartridge of games and give it to Ahbu to convince him to come to the dome for continuing the experiments.
I'm Ahbu the little elephant and I want a cartridge, do you have one?

, have you already been told that the turtles outside the Dome have been mutating uncontrollably? Trouble! They're a real kind of pests... So much effort's been made to exterminate them! These creatures hide in pipelines, feed on mushrooms and survive in places where nothing else can live.

These two plumber brothers, Marioch and Luzidj, have just set out to exterminate another brood...

But what I want to know is, what makes these turtles so resilient. It might still be caused by our effluent which carries the particles of Eden and Umoir floras...

Have you collected all the shells and dealt with Cuppa? Bravo! Now we have the opportunity to conduct a unique experiment testing the durability of turtle shells. I hope you've not left any traces on the "crime scene", or we might end up facing a new generation of turtles with a vengeful streak!

Especially not after that story with the princess... who hasn't been found yet! Even though Marioch and Luzidj have crawled through all kinds of filth...

Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Collect 6 samples of Umoir flora and 6 samples of Eden flora.

Greetings, colleague! I've already been told that you are the one to turn to when gathering samples is needed... Our Dome is currently conducting experiments on cultivating flora that is not typical for Xadagan − we grow the samples found by our employees while on scientific expeditions. At present, we have two types of biota − the exoplanetary one, from Eden, and the warped one from Umoir. Both of these are distinguished by their elevated content of the "life force" that manifests in very fascinating ways when juxtaposed against necrotic tissue.

It may be, though, that the currently available samples have less of that force, by the factor of... several times. We have, thus far, been unable to reach the same result as on the territories where the control samples had been taken.

Bring me the samples, , and I will perform the required measurements.
Have you managed to collect the samples?

Greetings, my favorite botanist!

We require the samples of Eden's flora. Eden is both the paradise on earth and a true trial for your skills, all at once. You need to collect the specimens of that wonderful plant life. I hope you're ready to face plants that can be both beautiful and dangerous as well?

Don't forget to make a self-snap with the most exotic samples − they might end up being the newest wonders of the Jeb-net!

Perfect! Have you collected the samples of Eden's flora? I hope they didn't try to bite you while being collected?!

Now, we can perform analysis and learn which of these plants might become the base for new dishes... or maybe even a whole new menu!

Who knows? You may have just discovered a new culinary direction! At any rate, this brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

Hey, hey, hey! Are you ready for a new trial? We need samples of flora from Umoir, this mutating, dangerous world. It will fall upon you to collect the plant specimens while making sure that none of them tries to "embrace" you with their tentacles. Be cautious: some of them might have quite... intriguing properties.

If you happen to encounter something truly bizarre, make a snap for the scientific report! Or for black humor.

Well done! Have you collected the samples of Umoir's flora? I hope they've not been trying to "massage" you on your way back here! We can now study their properties and find out how dangerous they are for our health... Or, conversely, if they might become the basis for a new type of Zombie cocktail!

This is going to be fun either way! Maybe... And another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Animated first, then killed, then animated again, then killed once more... So much for the life cycle.
Excellent! They are dead again now... And we will animate them if we need that.

Listen, we've got a bit of a problem with necrobeings − Necro-Yaks and Necro-Rhinos! These cyborgs were created with parts of dead animals and metal, and they're clearly not fitting with the idea of scientific progress as we understand it now. They are roaming our laboratories and evidently holding their own zombie contests for the honor of being called the most intimidating creatures around.

I want to find out how their biomechanical systems function with such a monstrous amalgamation of organic and mechanical parts. So be sure to act carefully − don't let them gain access to our experimental data! And deal with the "Precious" while you're at it − her skills are demoralizing the personnel...

Excellent! Have you dealt with this cybernetic threat? We can now analyze their biomechanical structure and learn how they were able to mesh living tissue with metal. Our work brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Put up 5 cameras in various places around the Dome and make photos. If you run out of cameras, Yasskul Bahadur can give you a spare.
Have you learned how to make snaps?
Wonderful! I hope the pictures turn out well −I'll check your desorotypes later!
Put up 5 cameras in various places around the Dome and make photos.

Ah, hello, my deardarling mentee! We have a little problem here... or, as I like to call it, a "scientific challenge". We need to learn what kind of change has occurred within our scientific grounds. And I thought you are the ideal mangirl for this job.

You see, I have a suspicion that the things that are happening there might cause not just scientific interest in you... but also the desire to run for the nearest cocktail bar. So grab your cameras and get to snapping! I hope you're not averse to some desorotyping... specifically to capture these "peculiar" changes.
Has the experiment been conducted successfully?
Collect 4 salt crystals, 4 mushrooms and 4 samples of black sludge from the pipes.
Have you managed to collect anything?

Wonderful! It just takes a glance to see that an incomprehensible mutation has occurred... All right, now we need to study it in more detail. For instance, what happens if that black sludge were to be ingested... Do you want to try? Alright, if you don't, I'll offer it to our Xadaganian interns...
Collect 12 samples of toxic hallucinogenic salt.

Wonderful! Have you collected the crystals? I see you're not just a brave ladlass, but a rather lucky one as well! We can now conduct experiments and learn how this particular salt might influence the perception of reality. Be ready for adventure in any case! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

Hey, you! Yes, it's you I'm talking to!

I need to have poisonous mutant mushrooms collected. They look like scintillating blue orbs − almost like those toys from your childhood, except they're more dangerous, and less safe to health.

And yes, they might cause hallucinations... or a desire to dance in the rain. So grab your containers and go hunting these "balls". I'm sure you'll be able to find them... without losing your head in the process!

Well done! Have you collected the mushrooms? I hope none of them were trying to "hug" you on your way back?

We can now study their properties and learn how toxic they are... or, conversely, how safe.

In any case, I'm ready for experimenting! This brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Collect 8 samples of black sludge from the pipes.

Hello, hello! I have a special task for you: collecting that greenish-black sludge from the sewers. Yes, yes, you heard it right, ladlass!

This sludge has peculiar properties − it might even become the basis for a new type of "otherworldly elixir".

But be careful: who knows what else might lurk in these depths? So put on your gloves and off you go − time to explore the depths of our scientific wonder!

Bravo! Have you collected the sludge?

We can now study its properties and learn how it might affect our health... or at least our mood. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

Hey, intern! We have a problem here... a very serious one!

The Dome's functions are facilitated by generators installed around its perimeter. If they stop working even for a second, the purity of our experiment will be compromised at once, because the system will lose its isolation. But current readings indicate that the generators are becoming unbalanced! Something needs to be done, and thankfully I have working compensator devices here. Installing three of them − one each on the northern, southern and western sides − will be enough! Get there at once and place them as soon as possible, !
Are the Deviance Removers not installed yet?
Install 4 deviance removers in specified points around the Dome.

Oh, my! Have you set up the generators? Excellent!

Our dome is now prepared again to protect us from all kinds of trouble. I hope you haven't got yourself burned with these wires and devices − that would've been too tragic for our project. Anyway, we can now proceed with our research without undue obstacles! And that brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
What is the price of knowledge? And are we ready to pay it for the sake of progress?
Destroy Bloodthirster and 12 Path of Blood heretics.

Have you dealt with these vampiric sadists? Excellent! We can now go about more important research − like learning why they love the color red so much. I hope we're not going to find any "bloody" books in their archives! And our research is bringing us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Have you dealt with this zombie problem? Excellent! We can now take to analyzing their cell structures so that we might learn how they were "processed" by the Imperial scientists. Research is bringing us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project!

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Eliminate 12 Executioner Zombies and Hickut's Executioner.

So, have you dealt with these Executioner Zombies? Excellent! We will now be able to study their methods and learn exactly how they've become so "proficient" at their trade. The data we receive brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t:
Listen up, we've got a real archaeological disaster here! The reanimated servants of the ancient Despot have risen again − and they're thinking that it's time to bring back the good old times, with pyramidal taxes and hydraulic reign!

Not only these folks are skilled with creating mummies − apparently, they are well versed in politics, too. I suspect that they're trying to resurrect their master and give us all a "necropolis revolution"! We are in peril of becoming the victims of another "despotic renaissance" unless you stop them.

So, move out, examine their motivation and put an end to this threat!

Well, is the problem solved? I hope you've not left any of the "mummies" alive! Now I can start studying their methods of reanimation. But there's a problem: I've lost several samples of their "necrosystems", and now we need to learn how they were able to enhance their dead bodies so quickly.

The new data brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t:
Are you aware that Negus Shuponu has finally greenlighted the experiment of creating huge Disassembly Robots? But something went wrong, as it always does: they've been hacked, and now they behave as though they are under the "Attack all humans!" spell! These mechanisms can disassemble just about anything down to the tiniest parts... in mere seconds.

I want to know what exactly has gone wrong with their software − could it be a virus, or too much code from old games was used! So grab your tools and wipe out these mechanical monsters before they disassemble the entire research center on the Cosmodrome!

Excellent! Have you dealt with these mechanical rioters? I can now go about studying their innards and finding out what kind of algorithm has caused this kind of unexpected behaviour. Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Talk to the cosmonauts and expose the disguised alien.

Have you exposed the alien? Excellent! Now we can study his methods of disguising himself and learn how exactly was he able to fool our entire space program. This is important for the Wireframe project's security.

Colleague!

We are happy to present our unique invention − the biobeam, or the Ray of Life! The Power of Light, the Gift of Tensess, Hirkalla's Engine? That's all so last century!

We can now reanimate whoever we want by using a simple device. We have managed to isolate the energy that permeates Eden and Umoir, we were successful in turning regular mana into the power that reanimates everything... And we've even filled someone who is already alive with this energy, making them stronger, faster, smarter!

But everything must be tested on control specimens! Do you want to know in greater detail about what we're doing, ?
Have you managed to test everything?
As you can see, our invention works well! This will change everything!
Use the Ray of Life on Ahbu and fight 6 robobeasts on the testing arena.
I bet on Ahbu − the power of the ray will make him unbeatable!
Exactly what was to be demonstrated! With the ray, our finest robobeast is unbeatable!
Use the Ray of Life on Ahbu and fight 6 robobeasts on the testing arena.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Use the Ray of Life on 8 plants inside the dome and 8 dead cyber-organisms: snakes, Necro-Yaks or Necro-Rhinos.
It will be exceedingly curious to see how dead flesh reacts to being affected with the beam...
Well, so the effect was even stronger than our calculations implied! It's curious now, what happens to living creatures, can the reaction become self-sustaining?
Use the Ray of Life on 12 cacti within the Dome.

Greetings to you, my inquisitive friend! I have a "prickly" task for you: irradiating our cacti with the special ray of life. Yes, exactly that! We want to learn how much they can grow and how... attractive they might become. It's like dating plants: the more attention you lavish on them, the greater your chances of success! So grab your ray gun and move out: time to make a cocktail of science and botanics!

Excellent! Have you irradiated all the cacti? I hope they didn't decide to spread their thorns around as gratitude for your care! We can now observe their growth and learn whether they can become the "stars" of our botanical show.

If everything sticks to the plan, we might even be able to create a new species of cactus intended for romantic parties!

Oh, great! Have you returned them to life?

I hope they didn't start seeking you out to hold, ah, an intimate party! We can now observe their behavior and learn how they react to the environment around them. If you're lucky, they might serve as inspiration for new scientific experiments... or at least for a good new joke! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Use the Ray of Life on 12 dead cyber-organisms − robosnakes.

Excellent! Have you reanimated the robosnakes? I hope they didn't start flirting with you! Now we can study their behavior and learn what's really going on inside their "hearts of iron".

If we're lucky, they might even help us with creating a new type of "robo-partners" for scientific experiments... or at least for parties! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Ask 5 juniour employees about the results of their experiments.

Let's not forget other experiments that are being run in the Dome. The interaction of the living and dead matter, the cybernetic and the necromantic, is our area of expertise. Our designs have helped with improving the lives of a great many Arisen, and we need to keep working in that direction.

For that, we need to collect the reports from our junior employees so we can single out the most promising directions. Collect their reports, , and I will study them later...
Excellent results, and each of them will become the start of a great new discovery sooner or later!
Ask 5 juniour employees about the results of their experiments.

Wonderful! Have you questioned them? Was it exciting to hear their "scientific" explanations? I hope you've not forfeited hope for their intelligence!

We now have the data required for analysis − let's hope they don't turn into another absurdist "masterpiece". Science demands sacrifice... and sometimes, also a good sense of humor! Remember, this brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Use the beam on 12 eggs outside the Dome.
Excellent! Now we only have to wait for the eggs to hatch, then we evaluate the results!
Use the beam on 12 eggs outside the Dome.

Greetings to you again! We have an exciting task: you need to use the Ray of Life on the eggs of unidentified reptiles outside the Dome.

Yes, I know, it sounds like the start of a bad horror cinema, but believe me: we're looking for the ideal mutant! Don't eschew precautions: these eggs may be not only "tasty", but quite dangerous as well. So grab your ray gun and go hunting for these "evolutionary masterpieces".

I hope you're not averse to take a little flight of imagination... what might hatch from these eggs?

Oh, my! Have you used the beam on the eggs? I hope they didn't try to throw you a messy party with their contents! Now we can observe the process to learn what our "experimental" eggs give us.

If we're lucky, we might be able to create a new "pet" for the labs... or at least for parties! Another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
O Nih... what are you doing with them? Alright, fine, I'll give you just one more.
We are the true bearers of scientific knowledge, the harbingers of progress!
Talk to Sarang Kido, complete 4 tasks given by her and the Dome's employees.
Have you managed to save the city?

The Committee is already aware of the extremely dangerous activities of Negus Pilis and his assistant, Yasskul Bahadur! We are arresting both for criminal negligence that very nearly lead to casualties among the citizens of Sar-Iram...

h: Looks like this is the effect of the beam...

t: Only some sort of miracle helped me with getting past all these snakes, toads, turtles and crocodiles!
Collect 6 barrels of toxins around the Dome and use them to inflict damage upon the enemies.

Thankfully, we have our own method of combating various biological objects! Over the years of our work, we've accumulated a huge stockpile of toxins... You can find them near the dome's generators. If you can gather enough of these barrels, you can freely toss them at the enemies! The mixture of acid and poison will leave them with no chances! But be careful not to get into a puddle of that stuff yourself, .
There's a fair amount of toxins there, and we've had no chance to dispose of them without haste.
Yes, we might be able to cobble together some sort of weapon by using them! We just have to find a convenient way to toss them as far as we can!
Collect 12 barrels of toxins around the Dome.

Hey, hey, hey! We are in need of your extraordinary abilities – we must collect barrels with exceedingly virulent toxins around the Dome. Yes, yes, you heard it right, ladlass!  Sure, I know it sounds like an invitation to a dinner with naught but venom served, but believe me: it is important science!

We must learn how these toxins might influence our ecosystem... or at the very least, our mood. So grab your gloves and go looking for these "treats"!

Excellent! Have you collected the barrels? We can now study these toxins and learn about their influence on our "scientific" environment.

If we're lucky, we might even end up creating a new kind of poisonous cocktail! Anyway, another day brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Activate 12 defense turrets around the Dome.
It's a shame they can't run... Though it also means Vanvaeck can't hack them, since they're not connected to the Jeb-net...
Indeed, the defense turrets are exceedingly effective, and they will be wiping out both heretics and mutants! We should fetch additional sets from the storage, just for some time in future...
Activate 12 defense turrets around the Dome.

Greetings to you again! We are in need of your help − the defense turrets around the Dome must be activated. Yes, exactly that!

These cute little pieces of machinery will be defending us against mutant reptiles and the Path of Poison Heretics trying to get in the way. I know you would have preferred to do something more "romantic", but believe me, this is necessary for our survival! So grab your tools and move out − time to make these turrets work towards our safety!

Bravo! Have you activated the turrets? I hope they didn't try starting a "fireworks party" for you straight out of the gate! We can now watch them go to work and make sure that they're really protecting us against all the threats.

The solid defense brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Eliminate 12 mutants and 1 particularly dangerous mutated crocodile around the Dome.
Have you tracked down the crocodile? They say it's grown to really monstrous size!
Eliminate 12 mutants and 1 particularly dangerous mutated crocodile around the Dome.

We have a real problem with mutant reptiles! These giant creatures can explode after their final mutation − it is as if you ran into a living, walking bomb!

I want to learn what is the exact trigger for such a catastrophic reaction in their biochemistry. So be careful: they might "greet" you with their volatile temper! Don't forget to bring protective gear along − we definitely don't want to lose a valuable researcher!

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: Kill 12 Path of Poison Heretics before they catch the mutated beasts.
I did get an offer to join the Heretics, once! But I declined...
Kill Poison Spitter and 12 Path of Poison Heretics.

Look, we've got an incursion by the Path of Poison Heretics − the original abusers of prohibited substances! They would consume anything they can find: from poisonous mushrooms to the chemical waste from our laboratories.

These folks are clearly intent on "experimenting" with creating a new kind of Arisen − or rather, new types of mutants! I want to learn what compounds they're using, and how that influences their physiology. So be cautious: they might offer you some of their "treats", but I would very much doubt their safety!

Have you dealt with this venomous problem? Perfect! Now I can analyze their "cocktails" and determine the exact components they were using for their sinister rituals. This brings us closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: New director of the Dome Laboratory

t: You and agent Makalani must arrest Negus Pilis and Yasskul Bahadur.
Oh, why did it have to be this way...
Ahh, so scandalous... how could we mix up these eggs! But haven't you seen: the beam was working all right... And the other experiments we did were quite successful, .

First off, let's arrest these criminals, and the we decide what to do next. The rest of the personnel will continue their work, and Sarang Kido will make sure they're not engaged in anything... prohibited!

Tell me when you're ready...

The next request has been filed: mechanical scorpions were observed on the allod's territory, and their numbers are over the critical threshold. We need to get rid of these creatures to ensure the safety of the populace. Like other mechanoids before them, they have been hacked by Negus Vanvaeck, and they might be dangerous, so you must act cautiously and thoroughly. I'm sure you're more than capable to deal with this task! Onward, and show them who's the boss here!
I fear it'll take a while to sort out the consequences of that hacking attack... But still, we're coming closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.

characters: Head of the Sar-Iram City Department

t: We won't be able to continue with the construction without metal... Thankfully we have enough now. And we are coming ever closer to the completion of the Wireframe project.
Start training in Jeb technologies of the Xadagan allod.
As you can see, it is very convenient! Use Jeb Converters and discover new horizons! The New Reality is nigh! Farewell, hero!
Be sure to hear all the messages!

This terminal allows to hear the speeches of Tep, the God of Death...

But first, you need to hear the previous part.
Access to Hairstyle Change service activated!
Activate the item and gain access to hairstyle change in the Xadagan network through the Sarekh-Ahau terminal.
